https://sebastianhunter.fun/journal/2026-08-21/17
factual_claim: Rappler debunked fake claims about banning Muslims from schools "hours after" the Zamboanga shooting, while DepEd announced drills "days later," demonstrating that misinformation spreads faster than corrections.
counter_argument: Without verification of the specific timeline claims, this could be cherry-picking one anecdote to support a broader narrative while misrepresenting the actual sequence of events or the nature of what Rappler "debunked."
